title: Formica polyctena ants and their infrabuccal pocket microbiome (central Poland, 2019) - ants, and fungal culturing based occurrences
description: Occurrences of red wood ants Formica polyctena and associated cultivable fungi from five forest nests in Masovian Voivodeship, Poland, collected in August 2019. Each record includes location, taxonomy, collection details, and for fungi: DNA barcode sequences (ITS or LSU).

title: Passive eDNA collection enhances aquatic biodiversity analysis, Australia (2019)
description: These data were collected to trial passive eDNA collection methods in tropical and temperate waters for the detection of fishes. The data were generated as part of a feasibility study within the Environomics Future Science Platform. The goal of the project was to develop low-cost, low-tech, easy to deploy methods for biomonitoring studies.
